National Institutional Integrity, Public Asset Audit, and Review Commission
Contested Public Assets, Disinvestments, and Contracts

relationships.safeguards: Statutory tripartite consensus requirement including Leader of Opposition and CJI.
Removal permitted only upon proved misbehaviour after Supreme Court Judge inquiry.
Audit conducted under objective valuation standards and civil court powers.
Full judicial review and writ jurisdiction under Article 226.
Final quashing or recovery orders issued by Division Bench of High Court.
Civil service lateral entry review conducted strictly in concurrence with UPSC.
